import Analysis.NormedSpace.Basic
import Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import Data.Real.Basic
import Tactic.Rewriting
import Tactic.Simp

open Real NNReal

theorem lg_target (r : NNReal) : HasSum (fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) 1 := by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  have h_sum : HasSum f 1 :=
    have : Sum (fun n => ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial) = Real.exp r := by
      simp only [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_zero, Real.mul_one, Real.one_mul]
      rw [Real.exp_eq_sum]
    rw [this] at h_sum
    exact mul_left_has_sum (Real.exp (-↑r)) 1
  exact h_sum
